object.name: Device.Hardware.
object.description: Represents the hardware configuration of the device, including details about the CPU, memory, and other hardware components.

object.name: Buttons.
object.description: This object contains the configuration and status of physical buttons present on the device.

parameter.name: ButtonNumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

object.name: Buttons.Button.{i}.
object.description: This object represents an individual physical button of the device. The button is typically discovered automatically from the system (e.g., via DeviceTree).

parameter.name: Name
parameter.description: Name of the button.

parameter.name: Label
parameter.description: The system-defined label for the button, often referencing its DeviceTree label.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: The current operational status of the button.

enumeration.description: Indicates the state when the button is being held down.
Indicates the default state when the button is not being pressed.
Indicates that a necessary configuration value is undefined or invalid.

parameter.name: Location
parameter.description: The location of the button as the user looks at the front of the device in its typical orientation.

parameter.name: InputFile
parameter.description: Specifies the full path of the input device for the button. (Eg: ''file:///dev/input/event0'') Which MUST use the uri scheme file {{bibref|RFC8089|The file URI Scheme}}.

parameter.name: TriggerConditionNumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

object.name: Buttons.Button.{i}.TriggerCondition.{i}.
object.description: This object defines the conditions for interpreting physical button presses into specific button events, such as a short press, long press, or release.

parameter.name: Enable
parameter.description: Enables or disables this {{object}} entry.

parameter.name: Name
parameter.description: The name of the TriggerCondition.

parameter.name: Type
parameter.description: The type of trigger condition, which determines when this {{object}} is activated.

enumeration.description: Indicates that this {{object}} will be activated when the button is pressed.
Indicates that this {{object}} will be activated when the button is released if it was pressed for a duration between {{param|Min}} and {{param|Max}}.
Indicates that this {{object}} will be activated when the button is pressed for a duration longer than {{param|Timeout}}.

parameter.name: Min
parameter.description: {{param}} and {{param|Max}} have to be set together. Both values MUST be expressed in {{units}}. If the button gets released between {{param}} and {{param|Max}}, this {{object}} is activated. This parameter will only be used when {{param|Type}} is set to {{enum|Released|Type}}.

parameter.name: Max
parameter.description: {{param|Min}} and {{param}} have to be set together. Both values MUST be expressed in {{units}}. If the button gets released between {{param|Min}} and {{param}}, this {{object}} is activated. This parameter will only be used when {{param|Type}} is set to {{enum|Released|Type}}.

parameter.name: Timeout
Active
parameter.description: This {{param}} indicates the activation status of the condition. It is set to {{true}} when this {{object}} is activated and will automatically reset to {{false}} after a duration defined by the {{param|ActiveTime}} parameter.

parameter.name: ActiveTime
parameter.description: This {{param}} specifies the duration for which the {{param|Active}} parameter will remain {{true}} after this {{object}} is activated, expressed in {{units}}.

command.name: Push()
command.description: Simulate a button push event for this button. This has only effect when the {{param|Status}} is {{enum|Released|Status}} or {{enum|Error_Misconfigured|Status}}.

parameter.name: Duration
parameter.description: Duration of the button press event, expressed in {{units}}. If this parameter is absent or set to '0', the button will be pressed indefinitely and will remain {{enum|Pressed|#.Status}} until the {{command|#.Release()}} is executed. If this parameter is present and set to a value greater than '0', the button will auto-switch to the {{enum|Released|#.Status}} state after the specified duration.

command.name: Release()
command.description: Simulate a button release event for this button. This has only effect when the {{param|Status}} is {{enum|Pressed|Status}} or {{enum|Error_Misconfigured|Status}}.

parameter.name: Duration
parameter.description: Duration of the button release event, expressed in {{units}}. If this parameter is absent or set to '0', the button will be released indefinitely and will remain {{enum|Released|#.Status}} until the {{command|#.Push()}} is executed. If this parameter is present and set to a value greater than '0', the button will auto-switch to the {{enum|Pressed|#.Status}} state after the specified duration.

event.name: Triggered!
event.description: Custom event based on the button event that occurred. This event also contains the name and type of the {{object|##.TriggerCondition.{i}}}, the name of the {{object|###.Button.{i}}}, and the {{param|Interval}} time.

parameter.name: Name
parameter.description: Value of the {{param|##.TriggerCondition.{i}.Name}}

parameter.name: ButtonName
parameter.description: Value of the {{param|###.Button.{i}.Name}}

parameter.name: Type
parameter.description: Value of the {{param|##.TriggerCondition.{i}.Type}}

parameter.name: Interval
parameter.description: Interval time from the time the button is pressed until this {{object}} is activated, expressed in {{units}}.

object.name: CPUs.
object.description: Represents the system's CPU configuration, providing details about each individual processor core, its capabilities, and its current operating state.

parameter.name: CPUNumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

object.name: CPUs.CPU.{i}.
object.description: Represents a single CPU instance with configurable parameters related to its operational settings.

object.name: CPUs.CPU.{i}.DVFS.
object.description: Represents the CPU's Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS) configuration. DVFS allows the operating voltage and frequency of the CPU to be dynamically adjusted to optimize power consumption and performance based on workload demands.

parameter.name: Enable
parameter.description:
Enables or disables Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS) for this CPU.
This parameter is only applicable if {{param|Supported}} is {{true}}.
If {{param|Supported}} is {{false}} and this parameter is {{true}} the {{param|Status}} will be set to {{enum|Unsupported|Status}}. When this parameter is set to {{false}}, the {{param|Status}} will be set to {{enum|Disabled|Status}}.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.description: Indicates the status of Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS) for this CPU.

enumeration.description: Indicates that DVFS is enabled and supported by the CPU.
Indicates that this CPU does not support DVFS, in which case {{param|Supported}} will be {{false}}.

parameter.name: Supported
parameter.description: Indicates whether this CPU supports DVFS.

parameter.name: CurrentFrequency
parameter.description: The current operating frequency of the CPU in {{units}}.

parameter.name: MinFrequency
parameter.description: The minimum frequency that the CPU hardware is capable of operating at, in {{units}}.

parameter.name: MaxFrequency
parameter.description: The maximum frequency that the CPU hardware is capable of operating at, in {{units}}.

parameter.name: ScalingMinFrequency
parameter.description:
The minimum operating frequency allowed for the CPU in {{units}}.
This value must be between {{param|MinFrequency}} and {{param|MaxFrequency}}, and part of the {{param|ScalingAvailableFrequencies}} list.
This value must be less than {{param|ScalingMaxFrequency}}.

parameter.name: ScalingMaxFrequency
parameter.description:
The maximum operating frequency allowed for the CPU in {{units}}.
This value must be between {{param|MinFrequency}} and {{param|MaxFrequency}}, and part of the {{param|ScalingAvailableFrequencies}} list.
This value must be greater than {{param|ScalingMinFrequency}}.

parameter.name: ScalingAvailableFrequencies
parameter.description: The available frequencies for CPU scaling in {{units}}.

parameter.name: ScalingGovernor
parameter.description: Indicates the CPU frequency governor to be used.

parameter.name: ScalingAvailableGovernors
parameter.description: A list of available CPU frequency governors for this CPU.
